inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: Operations Form 7263 was reviewed for the year 2026 and shows there have been no monthly fire extinguisher inspections.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The last sanitation inspection was completed 4/30/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Four of the operations fire extinguishers are in need of servicing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: Documentation of the most recent fire inspection was not available for review during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The faucet handle in the toddler restroom is broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined the director of the operation grabbed a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The caregiver in the Pre-K room was not aware of the number of children responsible for. The caregiver stated 18 children ages 3-5 years old were present. The children in the room were counted and a total of 19 children were present.     The caregiver in the School Age room was not aware of the number of children present. The caregiver stated 26 children ages 5-10 years old were present. The children were counted and it showed 27 children were present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Records were evaluated for eight children enrolled and the following was determined: The admission date is needed for three children. Four children need a special needs statement. Two children need emergency care information. One child needed authorization for emergency medical treatment. Five children need a health statement. Immunization records are needed for four children. Three children need emergency contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Written feeding instructions for one infant not yet on table food was last updated 06/24/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: During today's inspection I observed 6 children in the infant room. The youngest child was four months old and the oldest in the room was 23 months old. The oldest child was 19 months older than the youngest child.     Note: The operation removed the oldest child from the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Children were observed sleeping on numbered nap mats. The number/child assignment map posted was not followed in the two's and Pre-K classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies were reviewed and the following written policies are needed:    -Instructions for parents to contact the local office.  -Illness and Exclusion Criteria.  -Enrollment Procedures  -Procedures for parents to review a copy of the child-care center's most recent Licensing inspection report and how the parent may access the minimum standards online  -Safe Sleep for Infants.   -Immunization requirements.   -Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect.   -The parent handbook indicates two hours of screen time is allowed, however per minimum standards, one hour of screen time is allowed.   -Discipline and Guidance  -Abuse and Neglect   -Promotion of Indoor and Outdoor Activities  -Procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Records were evaluated for eight children enrolled and the following was determined:    Four children enrolled needed a special needs statement.   One child needed a health statement signed by a physician.   One child enrolled needed a food allergy emergency plan signed by the parent and physician.   One child needed an updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies were reviewed and the following written policies are needed:    -Instructions for parents to contact the local office, abuse and neglect hotline.  -Illness and Exclusion Policy.  -Procedures for parents to review a copy of the child-care center's most recent Licensing inspection report and how the parent may access the minimum standards online  -Safe Sleep for Infants.   -Hearing and Vision screenings.   -Immunization requirements.   -Vaccine Preventable Disease for Employees  -Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect.   -The parent handbook indicates two hours of screen time is allowed, however per  minimum standards, one hour of screen time is allowed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Personnel records were evaluated for eight staff members and the following was determined:      Documentation showing one caregiver meets minimum educational requirements is needed.     A notarized affidavit is needed for two staff members.     Background check letters of eligibility is needed for eight staff members.     Three staff members need photo identification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The fence around the outdoor playground is in need of repair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Records were evaluated for eight children enrolled and the following was determined:    Five children enrolled needed a special needs statement.   One child needed a health statement signed by a physician.   One child needed authorization for emergency medical care.   One child enrolled needed a food allergy emergency plan signed by the parent and physician.   An admission form for one child enrolled was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: The most recent sanitation inspection was not available for review during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The caregiver in the school age classroom was unaware of the number of children present. The caregiver stated nine children were present, however eleven were present in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The sign in and out logs were reviewed during today's inspection.     Ten of eleven children were signed in the after school classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The sign in and out logs were reviewed during today's inspection.     The sign in and out log for the infant classroom showed four of nine infants were signed in.     Six of ten children were signed in the after school classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: A ten month old was observed seated in a high chair. The safety straps were not fastened.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity: The operation has a current infant capacity of nine. During today's inspection a total of ten infants ages 3 months, 3 months, 3 months, 7 months, 7 months, 7 months, 7 months, 10 months, 11 months, and 15 months. The operation was over the infant capacity by one infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity (26 TAC §746.201(11))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver was observed lifting children under two years old by one arm during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver responsible for a group of children ages 3 months-18 months was unaware of the number of children present. occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The sign in and out log was review during this inspection and showed 16 of 20 children signed in.     Note: This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Upon arrival, one caregiver was caring for five infants ages 3 months, 3 months, 7 months, 7 months, and 9 months. The specified age group is 0-11 months. The maximum number of children one caregiver may supervise for this age group is 4. The caregiver was over ratio by one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
